task: The done_prepare convergence invariant counts reviewer-driven suite executions inside the REVIEW window as closeout thrash, so legitimate independent reviewer validates plus one receipt eviction permanently poison DONE for the current round.
outcome: A B-956f-shaped window (pre-TEST reviewer executed terminals plus one post-TEST closeout executed terminal in the same identity group) passes done_prepare convergence; two post-TEST duplicate executed terminals in one group, or any reused terminal with commandExecutions greater than zero, still hard-fail; review-window redundancy stays visible via a new observable telemetry field rendered in the convergence line.
facts: deriveDonePreparePassConvergence (packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1579) groups validation_terminal events by (commandSetHash, materialHash, storyFilesHash) and adds max(0, executed-1) plus all contradictory reused terminals to unchangedSuiteExecutions; assertDonePreparePassConvergence (:1628) requires 0.

The window is [last matching REVIEW entry, now) with no upper bound; events are append-only, so a poisoned round can only recover by bouncing DEV->REVIEW to move the anchor (observed on B-956f 2026-07-23 19:05).

B-956f real telemetry: executed cmdSet=34090591 at 18:25:19 REVIEW (reviewer lane), executed cmdSet=15aa0ab1 at 18:36:10 REVIEW (second lane, evicted the single-slot receipt in test-evidence.json), executed cmdSet=34090591 at 19:02:20 TEST (closeout validate, reuse refused due to evicted receipt) -> unchangedSuiteExecutions=1.
Replaying those events through the real derive+assert functions reproduces the exact failure (standalone repro executed 2026-07-24).

The same derivation already splits reviewer re-attestations into observable (reviewerReattestations) versus blocking (postTestReviewerReattestations, boundary = currentTestEntry.timestamp, comparison >=); facts.testEntryAt already carries that boundary.

The invariant was introduced by B-10b0 (commit d952808c92, 2026-07-17) to prove unchanged validation reuses PASS evidence; no doc under docs/requirements/decisions mentions unchangedSuiteExecutions, so no spec pins the current counting.
